_comment: Three featured repos, in README order. Star/fork/language come live from the API on every run; descriptions here override the repos' GitHub descriptions.

projects.description: OpenAI-compatible gateway for a local LLM that keeps latency predictable under load: bounded queue, explicit 429/503s and deadlines. 1,800 requests on vLLM, 0 errors.
Incident-response agent that acts only on evidence it observed: policy-checked actions, human approval, an append-only audit trail and crash-safe resume.
Can a LoRA-tuned 7B beat a prompted 14B at tool use? Scored by running its calls in a sandbox: 84-94% on unseen tasks vs 73%, about 5x faster.
